mechanism: Both agents cause vasodilation and reduce blood pressure through different pathways (sacubitril via neprilysin/ACE inhibition; tadalafil via PDE5 inhibition), creating additive hypotensive effects.
action: Monitor blood pressure closely; use tadalafil cautiously in patients on sacubitril, particularly at higher doses; counsel on orthostatic hypotension symptoms and avoid concurrent use if systolic BP <90 mmHg.
